actor_label: EMA Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP)
reported_state_or_fact: CHMP assesses initial centralised EU marketing authorisation applications; an assessment is not the Commission grant
notes: CHMP committee page; assessment not legal marketing permission.

actor_label: EMA Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP)
reported_state_or_fact: CHMP evaluates variations and nationally authorised medicines referred for a harmonised position; recommendations do not automatically replace national decisions
notes: Committee referrals and variation responsibilities distinct from all-national-medicine authority.

reported_state_or_fact: European Commission grants the binding centralised marketing authorisation following EMA scientific assessment
notes: Commission overview links Regulation (EC) 726/2004; current consolidated law and product decisions not audited here.

reported_state_or_fact: EMA procedural page describes Commission centralised authorisations as valid across EU plus Iceland Liechtenstein and Norway
notes: EEA-wide procedure is not WHO-Europe or EU constitutional membership; no per-product launch inferred.

actor_label: EU Member State national medicines authorities
reported_state_or_fact: Individual Member States also authorise medicines under national procedures distinct from centralised grants
notes: Does not identify which of 34 listed NCA organisations has a particular statutory power.

actor_label: EU Member State national medicines authorities
reported_state_or_fact: Mutual-recognition procedure is a separate multi-country route for marketing authorisation distinct from the centralised EMA process
notes: No evidence that a particular product or national authority used this procedure.

actor_label: EU Member State national medicines authorities
reported_state_or_fact: Decentralised procedure is another separate multiple-country authorisation route distinct from the centralised EMA process
notes: No assumption of a universal approval in all states or automatic member-agency legal remit.

reported_state_or_fact: EMA medicine search covers EMA-evaluated medicines and does not constitute a complete register of nationally authorised treatments
notes: A missing product in EMA search is not evidence the product is unauthorised nationally or clinically inappropriate.

reported_state_or_fact: Commission Union Register includes centralised marketing authorisations and selected other Commission decisions including suspended withdrawn or refused cases
notes: Presence in this register is not proof of current commercial availability or unrestricted authorisation; it is not every national register.

reported_state_or_fact: EMA disclaims control over medicine pricing and availability; regulatory marketing authorisation alone does not confirm local stock or access
notes: No patient treatment claim and no inference about reimbursement or physical supply.

reported_state_or_fact: Commission summary describes compulsory central route for qualifying post-2004 new active substances intended for diabetes and specified other conditions
notes: Not every diabetes or other chronic-disease medicine is centrally authorised; source summary is not a product-level legal opinion.
